dense_document_representation.description_excluded: historical descriptions and leaf taxonomy repeat/noise the title; title, brand, and top category are the served representation

metric_definitions.recall_at_k: relevant hits in top k divided by min(k, total relevant documents)
metric_definitions.mrr: reciprocal rank of the first relevant document; zero when none is retrieved
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_10: binary DCG at 10 divided by ideal binary DCG for min(10, total relevant documents)
metric_definitions.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean across queries in each slice

fusion_parameters.weighted_normalization: min-max independently within each top-100 candidate list; missing candidate score is zero

model_selection_rule.primary: highest paraphrase recall_at_10 on this frozen query set
model_selection_rule.adoption_gate: enable dense retrieval only for a material frozen-evaluation improvement without unacceptable measured runtime cost
model_selection_rule.materiality_threshold: paraphrase recall_at_10 must improve by at least 0.10 absolute over BM25
